about: What each UMS job needs, in the order to set it up. `ums needs <job>` checks the local items and prints the rest as steps. MCP servers ship in the plugin's .mcp.json, so Claude always sees them; until the person signs in through /mcp they show as needing authentication. Claude never skips a job or quietly does a weaker version because a tool is missing: it says exactly what to connect, in this order.
